triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: HTS 9903.02.02 excepts products described in headings 9903.01.30-9903.01.33 and 9903.02.78, but the encoded heading-product exception listed only the 9903.01.30-.33 set, so an article described in 9903.02.78 would wrongly have taken the +15% reciprocal duty.
triage.triage_notes: Provision read through the pinned corpus release: the source text is verbatim 'except for products described in headings 9903.01.30-9903.01.33 and 9903.02.78, and except as provided for in headings 9903.01.34 and 9903.02.01'. The fix adds the disjunct article_described_in_heading_9903_02_78 to the formula and correspondingly widens the proof-atom excerpt and the module summary (provenance carried along with the substantive fix). The companion test adds a true-witness case binding the new input. This is the F1 finding of the family-B r1 cross-review; PR #1197 returned zero reviews/review comments in the bundle, so the commit message is the evidence.
triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as excerpt/summary-only provenance or as added coverage the module never claimed, and both attempts fail: the diff changes the executable formula of `reciprocal_afghanistan_heading_product_exception_applies`, adding the disjunct `or article_described_in_heading_9903_02_78`, and that judgment feeds `reciprocal_afghanistan_additional_duty_applies` via `and not ...`, so the pre-fix module levied the +15% on an article described in 9903.02.78. The pinned corpus text of us/statute/hts/9903.02.02 (release us-rulespec-2026-08-03, provision sha 3bd6aa7d…) reads "except for products described in headings 9903.01.30-9903.01.33 and 9903.02.78", and the pre-fix formula covered only .30, .31, and the .32/.33 imports, so the omission was a disagreement with the cited source, not a scope enhancement. The rule already claimed to encode the whole heading-product exception set, so this is a missing exception being added back, which is exactly unrepresented_clause rather than amount, boundary, or polarity. The concurrent summary and proof-atom excerpt edits are provenance riding along with the meaning change, not the substance of it.
triage.verifier_notes: Decisive evidence is diff line 27 of scratchpad/diffs/us/75a3677870/001.diff plus the resolved provision text. Adversarial angle worth recording but not enough to reclassify: 9903.02.78 may have entered the HTS text after the module's single version window opens (effective_from '2025-08-07'), and the fix adds the exception to that one version without a version split, so if .02.78 postdates 2025-08-07 the module now applies the exception slightly retroactively. That is a separate, unfixed period question about the repaired module, not a better description of the defect this commit corrected; the resolver only exposes the current expression (expression_date 2026-07-31), so I could not date the heading's insertion read-only. Also note commit message F1 states the fix "includes 9903.02.78 per the rev12 heading text; verbatim atom added and a true-witness test case binds the new input" — i.e. a companion test case accompanies the formula change, consistent with a meaning change rather than bookkeeping. Other modules in this commit (floor stubs, terminated predecessors) are separate candidates and were not assessed here.
